new_value: Parsed requirements - Root signature verification is achieved via: (1) Link-layer Schnorr sigs on all RPL msgs - MUST per draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00.md:8.2; (2) Receiver MUST reject unsigned RPL frames; (3) Nodes SHOULD verify root legitimacy per Section 8.4; (4) Root pubkey TOFU-pinned or pre-provisioned; (5) DODAGID == AddrForKey(root_pubkey) provides cryptographic binding. No separate DIO Root Authorization Option wire format is defined - verification uses existing link-layer signature + DODAGID/pubkey binding. For TDMA beacons (CCP), spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:2a.5.1 defines MUST requirements for Schnorr48 signature verification.
